messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 6805551212 — high-severity: GPU OOMs during prefill observed on pool gpu-serving-west-1. 45 container restarts in last 6m, 3 nodes flapped. Paging on-call.

sre_joe: I'm on it. which pool & customer impact? paging eng-runtime.

maya_engineer: seeing repeated CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION in container logs + prefill memory spike. Stack points to prefill path allocating full KV cache for long prompts (~>3500 tokens).

eng-runtime: confirmed. metric: prefill_memory_bytes jumps from 12GB -> 40GB for ~1% of requests (long windows). Prefetch + no-eviction = OOM. Root cause likely long-context requests bypassing prefix trimming.

alex_oncall: customers? Lina from cust-ops, can you check affected tenants and throttle policy?

lina_custops: quick check: 4 enterprise tenants on Dedicated saw 5-12% request failures last 10m, some streaming disconnects. Notified CSE for immediate customer DM. ETA for public update: 15m.

ben_platform: short-term mitigation options: 1) lower max_prefill_tokens to 2048 globally for hosted pool, 2) enable aggressive KV eviction for prefill path, 3) route >2048 token requests to fallback coldmodel or queue. Which do we want now?

maya_engineer: do 1 + 2 now. That should stop OOMs quickly. We'll instrument a dynamic rollout so we can revert.

eng-runtime: patch ready. command:
```bash
# reduce prefill limit
kubectl patch config runtime-config -p '{"spec":{"prefill_window_limit":2048}}'
# enable eviction mode
kubectl patch config runtime-config -p '{"spec":{"kv_cache_eviction_policy":"aggressive"}}'
```

deploy-bot: Started rollout of runtime-config to cluster gpu-serving-west-1 (canary -> 3/10 nodes) at 6805551218.

sre_joe: monitoring metrics. prefill OOM rate dropping? log tail shows fewer CUDA resets.

maya_engineer: after canary looks good. applying to remaining nodes.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete at 6805551232. No failing pods remaining in shard.

lina_custops: Updated customers with preliminary mitigation note. ETA for full RCA and long-term fix: 48-72h. Will escalate to account teams for those with SLA concerns.

eng-runtime: followups: add prompt-length gating on edge, add queueing for oversized prefill, and test KV eviction under synthetic long-context load. Created ticket #RT-3421.

alex_oncall: handing off to night on-call (ben_platform) — leave the runbook + links in thread and ping when stable.

ben_platform: ack. will monitor for next 4h and start postmortem draft. ping me oncall if rate goes >1%.
notes: mitigation: lowered prefill_window_limit to 2048; enabled kv cache aggressive eviction; routed oversized requests to fallback. customers notified. handoff to night on-call. followup ticket RT-3421 created.
